info.name: Exposed .env configuration file
author: rajdoll
info.description:
The application serves its .env file over HTTP. These files usually hold database
credentials, API keys, and other secrets.
info.remediation: Keep .env outside the web root and block dotfiles in the web server configuration.

request:
GET /.env HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:18080
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_10) AppleWebKit/537.16 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/8.0 Safari/537.16
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 68
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 07:26:02 GMT
Server: uvicorn
Server: rajdoll-testapp/1.0

APP_ENV=production
DB_HOST=db
DB_PASSWORD=testapp-not-a-real-secret
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_10) AppleWebKit/537.16 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/8.0 Safari/537.16' 'http://127.0.0.1:18080/.env'
